gripOrHq.title: Washington, D.C., City Grid
gripOrHq.rulesText:
The difficulty of agendas installed inside this fort is reduced by 1.
Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

discardCards.title: Custodial Position
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

discardCards.title: Private LDL Access
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

rig.title: Krash
rig.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

root.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
root.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.
